items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: in the band, as I remember, was Frank [Parsley.] ... The bass player's name was Jonsey.

ctx.x: And so this was my first big band to work in, and the way the band was dressed, they wore pinstriped pants frock tail and long tail^coats, and ascots -- ascot ties and collars. So you know, they were the Fourteen Gentlemen from Harlem, and they were really, you know -- no one was really dressing like that in bands, so I think it was really kind of unique.

And so they wanted me to join the band, and so I'm the youngest guy in the band, and I was the teetotaler, and I didn't drink or smoke and I just hadn't been around people who did a lot of swearing, and in the band, as I remember, was Frank [Parsley.] Frank [Parsley] was a guitarist; really a good musician. The bass player's name was Jonsey. Before I joined the band, when they went overseas, Jonsey was playing tuba in the band, and then the tubas went out, and he had to learn to play a string bass, you know.
